Services

What the salon does

From what clients write in their Google reviews.

Keratin and treatments

Keratin treatments and hair botox for smooth, shiny hair that is easier to comb.

Colour and balayage

Colouring and balayage, and colour correction when hair comes in patchy or orange from somewhere else.

Bridal hair and styling

Wedding hair that lasts all day and night, blow-dries and quick styling in a few minutes.

Extensions and products

Hair extensions, and professional hair care products to use at home.

Easy to reach

From the Google listing and what clients write.

Book online

Appointments can be booked online through Fresha, linked from the Google listing.

At short notice

One client writes that even when she asks at the last minute, the salon always finds a slot for her.

Products delivered

Hair care products can be ordered through Wolt, and one client found small gifts in her order.

A salon with a glass front in Larnaca

The Hair Bar sits on Inomenon Ethnon, behind a large glass front with a small terrace outside. Inside are styling chairs in front of a long mirror, a wash area and a shelf of hair care products. The salon is women-owned, and many clients call it the best hair salon in Larnaca.
